title: Manufactured Home Insurance Discounts and the Discount Cap
content:
Three discounts are available on Manufactured Home Insurance. Each applies only when its own condition is met on the policy's rating facts as they stand on the quote, renewal or endorsement date; the discounts that apply are added together, and the sum is capped at the form's maximum total discount.

## Discount conditions

| Discount | Applies when | Rate (all six forms) |
|---|---|---|
| Claims-free | The insured has had no paid claim in the claims-free lookback of 5 years | 10% |
| Protective device | A monitored smoke and fire alarm is on file for the policy | 5% |
| Paid in full | The policy is on the annual plan, the annual premium being paid in full at the start of the term | 6% |

## Cap on the sum of discounts

| Policy form | Maximum total discount |
|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | 20% |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | 20% |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | 20% |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | 20% |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | 25% |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | 25% |

The total discount is the sum of the rates of the discounts that apply, or the form's maximum total discount if that sum is higher.

## Combination table

| Discounts that apply | Sum | Total discount, forms capped at 20% | Total discount, forms capped at 25% |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Protective device | 5% | 5% | 5% |
| Paid in full | 6% | 6% | 6% |
| Claims-free | 10% | 10% | 10% |
| Protective device and paid in full | 11% | 11% | 11% |
| Claims-free and protective device | 15% | 15% | 15% |
| Claims-free and paid in full | 16% | 16% | 16% |
| All three | 21% | 20% | 21% |

Only the combination of all three discounts reaches a cap, and only on the four forms whose maximum total discount is 20%.

## Points of judgement

- The claims-free condition looks at paid claims only, over the 5 years of the lookback.
- The protective-device discount turns on a monitored smoke and fire alarm being on file for the policy.
- A policy on the semi-annual, monthly EFT or loan escrow plan is not on the annual plan, so the paid-in-full discount does not apply to it.
